title: Fourth moment bounds the number of encoded tuples
statement: Let $W$ be a finite type, and let $n,k\in\mathbb N$. If there is an injective map from $W$ into the set of ordered quadruples of subsets of $[n]$, each of size $k$, whose symmetric difference is empty, then $|W|$ is at most the uniform average over $x\in\{−1,1\}^n$ of the fourth power of the level-$k$ polynomial evaluated at $x$.
hypotheses_covered: An injective encoding of $W$ into the specified quadruples exists
